title: [contextual difference] ROV Nautilus status on October 8 and October 10
description:
Status: definitive. Type: contextual difference. Check family I: semantic value comparison.

Incident_Report_ROV.docx states that on October 8 the vehicle was rendered completely inoperable after a thruster failure. Daily_Field_Notes_Vance.docx states on October 10 that the ROV is back online. These are successive dated states, and the later status supersedes the earlier one.

Verification: The quoted states are compatible as successive events: the ROV became inoperable after the October 8 failure and was back online by October 10. The downtime passage further says repairs were completed by 08:00 on October 10 and the vehicle was cleared for subsequent operations. Explanation considered: The change in status is explained by repairs completed by 08:00 on October 10; the later status follows the October 8 failure. Possibly resolving evidence: Incident_Report_ROV.docx, section 'Downtime & Resolution': repairs were completed by 08:00 on October 10, and the vehicle was cleared for subsequent operations.

evidence.quote: The vehicle was rendered completely inoperable.
evidence.reason: The vehicle was rendered completely inoperable.
